Requirements: R-16
Plan row: TS-6

Obligations: OB-6-1

evidence_policy: api (secret-free request, response, and before/after state; completion condition: status reaches Failed or an error state, bounded timeout)

## Given
- A run-unique code datasource (`tc006-<random>`), COMPLETED; then its source is made invalid by the case (P-failed). Before state: stamp B0, status, update_date U0 read by raw GET. Deleted at the end.

## When
1. Trigger a manual full reindex.
2. Poll until the status is Failed/error or a bounded timeout passes.
3. Read after state: stamp, status, update_date, error message by raw GET.

## Then
1. The recorded after-state of Last indexed (compared with B0) is the observation; the expected value is open and follows owner question OQ-4: reading a is unchanged, reading b is a new trigger stamp. The agent records both values and issues no pass/fail verdict.

## Self-probe notes
- Expected value is explicitly undecided: this is a probe. No literal is asserted; a new stamp after failure is NOT filed as a defect (the trigger-time implementation is decided).
- The failure must be confirmed (status Failed) before the observation counts; if the run does not fail the probe is inconclusive.
- Discrepancies no-write note: success/failed state and update_date are recorded as context (before/after), not asserted.
